parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The client ID. When you delete a snapshot of ECS File Backup Standard Edition, you must specify either this parameter or InstanceId
parameters.help_zh: 客户端ID。删除ECS文件备份标准版快照时，与InstanceId二者必选其一
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup snapshot
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup source type. Valid values:
ECS_FILE: backup snapshots of ECS File Backup Standard Edition.
OSS: backup snapshots of Alibaba Cloud OSS.
NAS: backup snapshots of Alibaba Cloud NAS.
UDM_ECS: backup snapshots of entire ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
备份源类型。取值范围：
ECS_FILE：表示ECS文件备份标准版的备份快照。
OSS：表示阿里云OSS的备份快照。
NAS：表示阿里云NAS的备份快照。
UDM_ECS：表示ECS整机的备份快照
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The ECS instance ID. When you delete a snapshot of ECS File Backup Standard Edition, you must specify either this parameter or ClientId
parameters.help_zh: ECS实例ID。删除ECS文件备份标准版快照时，与ClientId二者必选其一
parameters.name: instance_id

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. Generally, successful is returned for a successful request, and a specific error message is returned for a failed request
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败
